name: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model download + Neuron compile (V3 TP16, TP=16 DP=2)
description: trn2.48xlarge 上で (1) HF model snapshot 取得, (2) compile.sh v3_tp16 を 1 回だけ走らせて Transformer / VAE / Vision Encoder / Language Model を compile し COMPILED_MODELS_DIR に置く。冪等: COMPILED_MODELS_DIR に transformer_v3_cfg/ + vae_encoder/ + vae_decoder/ + language_model_v3/ + vision_encoder_v3/ が揃っていれば SKIP。 NeuronCore 32-63 (32 cores, world_size=32, TP=16 DP=2) を専有。 ~90-120 min かかるので TASK_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS=7200 を必ず設定。 source tarball は presigned S3 URL で配布。

tasks.name: Verify Neuron venv + nvme path
tasks.description: venv が存在し、 /mnt/local が存在することを確認 (compile artifact は nvme に置く)。
commands: test -d /mnt/local || { echo '[NG] /mnt/local not found (DLAMI nvme partition is required)'; exit 1; }
command -v neuron-ls >/dev/null || echo '[WARN] neuron-ls not in PATH (continuing)'

tasks.name: Skip if all V3 CFG artifacts already exist
tasks.description: transformer_v3_cfg/ + vae_encoder/ + vae_decoder/ + language_model_v3/ + vision_encoder_v3/ が揃っていれば exit 0。
commands: if [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' = 'true' ]; then echo '[INFO] FORCE_RECOMPILE=true, will recompile'; exit 0; fi
for d in transformer_v3_cfg vae_encoder vae_decoder language_model_v3 vision_encoder_v3; do
if [ $missing -eq 0 ]; then echo '[OK] all artifacts present, skip compile'; mkdir -p {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}} && touch {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}}/.precompile_skipped; exit 0; fi
echo '[INFO] some artifacts missing, will compile'

tasks.name: Fetch source tarball (compile.sh + neuron_qwen_image_edit/ + run_qwen_image_edit.py + serve.py)
tasks.description: presigned S3 URL から tarball を WORK_DIR に展開。
commands: if [ -f {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}}/.precompile_skipped ] && [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' != 'true' ]; then echo '[OK] skipped (cached)'; exit 0; fi
test -n '{{SOURCE_TARBALL_URL}}' || { echo '[NG] SOURCE_TARBALL_URL is empty'; exit 1; }
test -f {{WORK_DIR}}/compile.sh || { echo '[NG] compile.sh missing after extract'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Install Python deps for compile (diffusers, transformers, etc.)
tasks.description: venv に compile に必要な diffusers/transformers/accelerate/qwen-vl-utils を入れる。 huggingface_hub は既存。
commands: if [ -f {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}}/.precompile_skipped ] && [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' != 'true' ]; then echo '[OK] skipped (cached)'; exit 0; fi
{{VENV}}/bin/python -c 'import diffusers, transformers; print("diffusers", diffusers.__version__); print("transformers", transformers.__version__)'

tasks.name: Run compile.sh v3_tp16 (~90-120 min, NeuronCore {{NEURON_CORES}}, world_size=32)
tasks.description: compile.sh v3_tp16 は VAE + Transformer (V3 TP16) + Language Model + Vision Encoder の 4 コンポーネントを順に compile する。 NeuronCore は 32-63 (32 cores, world_size=32, TP=16, DP=2)。 24 attention heads は 32 にパディングされ 16 rank に分割 (2 heads/rank、25% padding overhead)。 edit ステージのレイテンシ削減を最優先。
commands: if [ -f {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}}/.precompile_skipped ] && [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' != 'true' ]; then echo '[OK] skipped (cached)'; exit 0; fi
echo '[INFO] starting compile.sh v3_tp16 (this populates Neuron compile cache, ~90-120 min)'

id {{SERVE_USER}} >/dev/null 2>&1 && { chown -R {{SERVE_USER}}:{{SERVE_USER}} {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}} && chmod -R u+rwX,go+rX {{COMPILED_MODELS_DIR}}; } || echo '[WARN] {{SERVE_USER}} missing on this host; skipping chown (server will need manual ownership fix)'

tasks.name: Verify all V3 CFG artifacts present
tasks.description: transformer_v3_cfg/ + vae_encoder/ + vae_decoder/ + language_model_v3/ + vision_encoder_v3/ が空でないことを確認。
commands: for d in transformer_v3_cfg vae_encoder vae_decoder language_model_v3 vision_encoder_v3; do
if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "[NG] $d is empty"; exit 1; fi
echo '[OK] all V3 CFG artifacts verified'
